snippet.title: Reigns: The Witcher | Launch Gameplay Trailer | Out Now
snippet.description:
Get Reigns: The Witcher on PC and mobile, out now! Visit https://www.reignsgame.com/the-witcher for more.

Reigns: The Witcher is the latest mutation of the smash-hit swipe ‘em up Reigns series from Nerial and Devolver Digital, set in the merciless, dark-fantasy world of CD PROJEKT RED’s award-winning The Witcher series. 

As legendary monster slayer Geralt of Rivia, you will fight for survival within the drunken ballads of his dear friend, Dandelion the bard. Will you hunt monsters, upset the locals, or run a hot bath? Navigate the moral meanderings of the world through the eyes of the bard, and compose an inspiring epic to perhaps, one day, claim immortality. 

Swipe right, swipe left, seek glory, find death! 

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reigns-the-witcher/id6736946286
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.devolverdigital.ReignsWitcher
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1651600/Reigns_The_Witcher/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/reigns_the_witcher

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
